source.stem:
The table describes four different resistance wires. They are all made from the same metal.
Which wire has the smallest resistance?

intelligence.enrichment: The incident ray, the normal to the mirror at the point of incidence, and the reflected ray all lie in the same plane. same-plane alignment allows the reflected beam to be seen on the flat sheet The learner explains that the incident ray, normal, and reflected ray lie in the same plane and uses the bent-sheet observation as evidence. The reflected beam should stay visible anywhere on the same sheet because bending the sheet does not matter.
